about: The help site's pages, in order (PLAN.md D210). Each has site/content/zh/<slug>.md and site/content/en/<slug>.md, but the first: it is the landing page (D214), its words in components/Landing.tsx. Each other page is in a group of the bar across the top -- install, use, help -- with a line that says what it is for (D221). The legal pages (group legal, in the foot) have no words of their own: their `source` is the repository's own files for each language, read at build, the ones every package carries (D223).
